description.fun: Deino can't see, so it learns about the world by bumping into things and biting them, and its body is covered in wounds. Food is scarce in the deep caves where it nests, so it sinks its teeth into anything that moves, and if it likes the taste, it memorises the scent. Expect to be bitten until one warms up to you. Its line was first meant to look like tanks before being reworked around the eight-headed Yamata no Orochi.
description.guide: Deino is a Dark- and Dragon-type Pokémon that cannot see, so it explores by biting and tackling things. It lives deep in caves. It evolves into Zweilous, then Hydreigon.
description.tagline: A blind little dragon that bites first and asks questions later.

description.fun: Zweilous's two heads don't get along at all. They compete over every bite, and whichever eats more gets to be leader, so it always overeats and is covered in scars even without fighting anyone else. If you don't give both heads equal attention, they start fighting out of jealousy. Once it has eaten everything in an area, it moves on, its heads bickering over which way to go. Tank-tread markings on its belly are left over from an early design.
description.guide: Zweilous is the evolved form of Deino, a Dark- and Dragon-type Pokémon with two heads that constantly compete for food. It evolves into Hydreigon.
description.tagline: A two-headed dragon whose heads fight over every meal.

description.fun: Hydreigon soars on six wings and attacks anything that moves, its three heads taking turns to bite until the target goes down. Only the central head has a brain: it's very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction, and stories tell of whole villages it destroyed. It's said to have grown ferocious because ancient people saw it as evil incarnate and attacked it relentlessly. It's based on Yamata no Orochi, with fewer heads to look less off-putting.
description.guide: Hydreigon is the final form of Deino, a Dark- and Dragon-type Pokémon with three heads, though only the middle one has a brain. It is fierce and attacks anything that moves.
description.tagline: A three-headed dragon whose only thought is destruction.
